title: Proper flat morphisms finite over a dense open are finite
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $U\subseteq S$ be an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] whose underlying subset is dense, meaning that every nonempty open subset of $S$ meets $U$. Suppose that $X_U=X\times_S U\to U$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Then $f$ is finite.
